title: Training run
description: The status of one training run. The run selector lists Levanter runs that reported a step in the dashboard window. Hero runs come first. The current hero run is the initial selection. Run identity uses run_id, so a run keeps one series set across clusters. Use the Runs dashboard to compare runs.

list.name: run
list.label: Run
list.description: Levanter runs that reported a step inside the dashboard window, hero runs first and newest first within each group. Sorting is left to the query, so the default selection is the newest hero run.
list.definition: SELECT run_id AS value FROM "telemetry_v1" WHERE service = 'levanter' AND name = 'step'

params.value: SELECT run_id AS value FROM "telemetry_v1" WHERE service = 'levanter' AND name = 'step' AND run_id IS NOT NULL AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) GROUP BY run_id ORDER BY CASE WHEN run_id LIKE 'hero-%' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, MAX(timestamp_ms) DESC

panels.title: Run status
panels.description: Where the run is right now. The window is a fixed fifteen minutes; the dashboard time range does not reach this panel. One query serves every tile, because a telemetry_v1 scan costs what its window costs whatever it selects, and ten stat panels would cost ten scans. Time since last step is the stall alert's own input, the age of the wall-clock stamp Levanter writes after each completed step. Sample age is the age of any telemetry from the run, so the two together separate a stalled trainer from a broken telemetry path.

params.value: SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN name = 'phase' THEN value END) AS phase, MAX(CASE WHEN name = 'step' THEN value END) AS step, MAX(CASE WHEN name = 'run_progress' THEN value END) AS progress, (CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now()) * 1000 AS BIGINT) - CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN name = 'progress_time_seconds' THEN value END) * 1000 AS BIGINT)) / 1000.0 AS since_last_step, AVG(CASE WHEN name = 'throughput_duration' THEN value END) AS step_time, AVG(CASE WHEN name = 'throughput_mfu' THEN value END) AS mfu, AVG(CASE WHEN name = 'throughput_tokens_per_second' THEN value END) AS tokens_per_second, MAX(CASE WHEN name = 'throughput_total_tokens' THEN value END) AS total_tokens, AVG(CASE WHEN name = 'train_loss' THEN value END) AS train_loss, (CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now()) * 1000 AS BIGINT) - MAX(timestamp_ms)) / 1000.0 AS sample_age_seconds FROM "telemetry_v1" WHERE service = 'levanter' AND name IN ('phase', 'step', 'run_progress', 'progress_time_seconds', 'throughput_duration', 'throughput_mfu', 'throughput_tokens_per_second', 'throughput_total_tokens', 'train_loss') AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT)

panels.title: Training loss by attempt
panels.description: Wall-clock loss for each Iris execution. Grafana disconnects a series after five minutes without data. A new series identifies a restart. Compare the endpoints to find a resume loss change.

params.value: SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS t, execution_uid AS series, AVG(value) AS train_loss FROM "telemetry_v1" WHERE service = 'levanter' AND name = 'train_loss' AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND execution_uid IS NOT NULL AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Training loss by step
panels.description: Training loss against Levanter step for the whole run, read from W&B rather than finelog. Finelog evicts telemetry segments once the namespace passes its storage policy, so a finelog query starts at the oldest retained step; the W&B run spans every restart back to step 0. The series is sampled server-side and the bridge caches it for a minute, so it lags the attempt panel. This panel ignores the Grafana time range. Use it for the continuous curve, and the attempt panel for outages and restarts.

panels.title: Loss spikes and skipped steps
panels.description: Peak loss against the optimizer's own rejection threshold, and how many steps the optimizer skipped. Levanter's skip-step rule rejects a step whose loss exceeds the trailing mean plus six standard deviations, so a peak crossing the threshold line with a matching skip is a spike the run absorbed. Both series are empty when the optimizer runs without skip-step; the loss-spike alert reads train_loss directly and covers that case.

params.value: SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS t, MAX(CASE WHEN name = 'train_loss' THEN value END) AS peak_loss, AVG(CASE WHEN name = 'optim_skip_step_loss_threshold' THEN value END) AS reject_threshold, SUM(CASE WHEN name = 'optim_skipped_step' THEN value END) AS skipped_steps FROM "telemetry_v1" WHERE service = 'levanter' AND name IN ('train_loss', 'optim_skip_step_loss_threshold', 'optim_skipped_step') AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Step time
panels.description: Mean and slowest seconds per step in each bucket, and how much of the mean was data loading and hooks. The slowest-step series is where a periodic cost shows: a checkpoint write or an eval lands on one step, lifting the maximum while the mean holds. Loading time growing into step time is an input-pipeline stall, which appears here well before it appears in loss.

params.value: SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS t, AVG(CASE WHEN name = 'throughput_duration' THEN value END) AS step, MAX(CASE WHEN name = 'throughput_duration' THEN value END) AS slowest, AVG(CASE WHEN name = 'throughput_loading_time' THEN value END) AS loading, AVG(CASE WHEN name = 'throughput_hook_time' THEN value END) AS hooks FROM "telemetry_v1" WHERE service = 'levanter' AND name IN ('throughput_duration', 'throughput_loading_time', 'throughput_hook_time') AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Throughput
panels.description: Model FLOP utilization on the left axis and token rate on the right. MFU is the throughput-regression signal that moves before loss does; tokens per second falls with it on a slowdown and without it on a smaller job.

params.value: SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS t, AVG(CASE WHEN name = 'throughput_mfu' THEN value END) AS mfu, AVG(CASE WHEN name = 'throughput_tokens_per_second' THEN value END) AS tokens_per_second FROM "telemetry_v1" WHERE service = 'levanter' AND name IN ('throughput_mfu', 'throughput_tokens_per_second') AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Run progress
panels.description: Fraction of the configured schedule completed on the left axis, tokens consumed on the right. The slope of the progress line is what a completion estimate rests on; it goes flat during a stall and steps backward when a restart resumes from an older checkpoint. Progress is only reported by a run configured with a total step count.

params.value: SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS t, MAX(CASE WHEN name = 'run_progress' THEN value END) AS progress, MAX(CASE WHEN name = 'throughput_total_tokens' THEN value END) AS total_tokens FROM "telemetry_v1" WHERE service = 'levanter' AND name IN ('run_progress', 'throughput_total_tokens') AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Optimizer
panels.description: Global gradient norm on the left axis and learning rate on the right. A gradient norm climbing while the schedule holds the learning rate flat is the shape that precedes a loss spike; a learning rate that moves without a schedule boundary means the run resumed with a different config.

params.value: SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS t, AVG(CASE WHEN name = 'grad_norm_total' THEN value END) AS grad_norm, AVG(CASE WHEN name = 'optim_learning_rate' THEN value END) AS learning_rate FROM "telemetry_v1" WHERE service = 'levanter' AND name IN ('grad_norm_total', 'optim_learning_rate') AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Evaluation loss
panels.description: Held-out and Paloma macro loss, one series per metric. Sparse by design -- evals run on a cadence, so points rather than lines.

params.value: SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS t, name AS series, AVG(value) AS value FROM "telemetry_v1" WHERE service = 'levanter' AND name IN ('eval_loss', 'eval_macro_loss', 'eval_paloma_macro_loss') AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Device memory
panels.description: HBM in use and peak against the allocator limit, from JAX's memory stats on the trainer's local device. Peak approaching the limit is what flips rematerialization on and costs throughput, so read it beside MFU. Only the hero trainers log this.

params.value: SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS t, AVG(CASE WHEN name = 'memory_in_use_gib' THEN value END) AS in_use, MAX(CASE WHEN name = 'memory_peak_gib' THEN value END) AS peak, MAX(CASE WHEN name = 'memory_limit_gib' THEN value END) AS limit_gib FROM "telemetry_v1" WHERE service = 'levanter' AND name IN ('memory_in_use_gib', 'memory_peak_gib', 'memory_limit_gib') AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Execution health
panels.description: Attempt age starts at the first phase sample for the current execution. Initialization age appears only before training progress. Orange marks the 45-minute initialization alert. Red marks the 60-minute startup-supervisor deadline. Task counts and retry events match the current execution cluster and job root.

params.value: WITH recent_phase AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') AS origin_cluster, job_id, execution_uid, value AS current_phase, timestamp_ms, seq FROM "telemetry_v1" WHERE service = 'levanter' AND name = 'phase' AND process_index = '0' AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND job_id IS NOT NULL AND execution_uid IS NOT NULL AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT)), current_execution AS (SELECT origin_cluster, job_id, execution_uid, current_phase FROM recent_phase ORDER BY timestamp_ms DESC, seq DESC, origin_cluster, job_id, execution_uid LIMIT 1), phase_history AS (SELECT phase.timestamp_ms, current_execution.current_phase FROM "telemetry_v1" AS phase JOIN current_execution ON COALESCE(NULLIF(phase."cluster", ''), 'marin') = current_execution.origin_cluster AND phase.job_id = current_execution.job_id AND phase.execution_uid = current_execution.execution_uid WHERE phase.service = 'levanter' AND phase.name = 'phase' AND phase.run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND phase.timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT)), attempt AS (SELECT (CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now()) * 1000 AS BIGINT) - MIN(timestamp_ms)) / 1000.0 AS attempt_age_seconds, MAX(current_phase) AS current_phase FROM phase_history) SELECT attempt_age_seconds, CASE WHEN current_phase = 0 THEN attempt_age_seconds END AS initialization_age_seconds FROM attempt

WITH recent_phase AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') AS origin_cluster, job_id, timestamp_ms, seq FROM "telemetry_v1" WHERE service = 'levanter' AND name = 'phase' AND process_index = '0' AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND job_id IS NOT NULL AND execution_uid IS NOT NULL AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - INTERVAL '90 minutes') * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now()) * 1000 AS BIGINT)), current_execution AS (SELECT origin_cluster, job_id FROM recent_phase ORDER BY timestamp_ms DESC, seq DESC, origin_cluster, job_id LIMIT 1), roots AS (SELECT state.ts, state.pending, state.assigned, state.building, state.running, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY state.ts DESC) AS rn FROM "iris.task_state" AS state JOIN current_execution ON COALESCE(NULLIF(state."cluster", ''), 'marin') = current_execution.origin_cluster AND (current_execution.job_id = state.root_job_id OR current_execution.job_id LIKE CONCAT(state.root_job_id, '/%')) WHERE state.ts >= now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes') SELECT pending + assigned + building + running AS active_tasks, running, pending, assigned, building, (CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now()) * 1000 AS BIGINT) - CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ts) * 1000 AS BIGINT)) / 1000.0 AS task_state_age_seconds FROM roots WHERE rn = 1

WITH recent_phase AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') AS origin_cluster, job_id, timestamp_ms, seq FROM "telemetry_v1" WHERE service = 'levanter' AND name = 'phase' AND process_index = '0' AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND job_id IS NOT NULL AND execution_uid IS NOT NULL AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - INTERVAL '90 minutes') * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now()) * 1000 AS BIGINT)), current_execution AS (SELECT origin_cluster, job_id FROM recent_phase ORDER BY timestamp_ms DESC, seq DESC, origin_cluster, job_id LIMIT 1), retry_events AS (SELECT event.ts FROM "iris.task_event" AS event JOIN current_execution ON COALESCE(NULLIF(event."cluster", ''), 'marin') = current_execution.origin_cluster AND event.task_id LIKE CONCAT(current_execution.job_id, '/%') WHERE event.reason IN ('TaskRetryScheduled', 'CoscheduledSiblingRequeued') AND event.ts >= now() - INTERVAL '7 days') SELECT COUNT(*) AS retry_events, (CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now()) * 1000 AS BIGINT) - CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM MAX(ts)) * 1000 AS BIGINT)) / 1000.0 AS since_last_retry FROM retry_events

panels.title: Token drops
panels.description: The total, sender, and receiver token-drop fractions. The run-health limit is 7%, above intermittent 5% spikes.

params.value: SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS t, AVG(CASE WHEN name = 'moe_drop_fraction' THEN value END) AS drop_fraction, AVG(CASE WHEN name = 'moe_sender_drop_fraction' THEN value END) AS sender_drop_fraction, AVG(CASE WHEN name = 'moe_receiver_drop_fraction' THEN value END) AS receiver_drop_fraction, CAST(0.07 AS DOUBLE) AS alert_threshold FROM "telemetry_v1" WHERE service = 'levanter' AND name IN ('moe_drop_fraction', 'moe_sender_drop_fraction', 'moe_receiver_drop_fraction') AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Router health
panels.description: Routing entropy and router-bias bounds. The hero monitor warns below 5.92 entropy or above a bias magnitude of 400.

params.value: SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS t, AVG(CASE WHEN name = 'train_router_routing_entropy_mean' THEN value END) AS routing_entropy, MAX(CASE WHEN name = 'train_router_bias_max' THEN value END) AS router_bias_max, MIN(CASE WHEN name = 'train_router_bias_min' THEN value END) AS router_bias_min, CAST(5.92 AS DOUBLE) AS entropy_minimum, CAST(400.0 AS DOUBLE) AS bias_upper_limit, CAST(-400.0 AS DOUBLE) AS bias_lower_limit FROM "telemetry_v1" WHERE service = 'levanter' AND name IN ('train_router_routing_entropy_mean', 'train_router_bias_max', 'train_router_bias_min') AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
